name: cortex
description: Concern-centric planning, story, bugfix, implementation, validation, and system documentation skills for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run concern-centric product and system change workflows.
interface.longDescription: Cortex packages a full Codex delivery process: create PRDs from product intent, suggest candidate epics when decomposition is needed, create executable epics one at a time, add scoped stories and surgical bugfixes inside active epics, validate one work item at a time, implement scoped changes, run objective validation, document current system knowledge, capture durable decisions as ADRs, and archive completed epic history. It also includes a skill-authoring workflow for maintaining reusable agent skills.
defaultPrompt: Use Cortex to turn this request into a PRD.
Use Cortex to add, validate, and implement a story in this active epic.
Use Cortex to add a surgical bugfix with regression checks.
Use Cortex to document current system knowledge.
